app.name: Atelier Inventory
app.tagline: Your dresses, photos and stock in one place.

auth.subtitle: Sign in to open the atelier.
auth.invalid: Email or password is incorrect. Check both and try again.

setup.title: Connect Supabase
setup.body: This build has no Supabase project configured, so sign-in and data are unavailable. Copy .env.example to .env.local, add your project URL and anon key, then restart the dev server.

capture.title: Capture
capture.body: Photo capture and upload arrive in the next phase.

materials.title: Materials and accessories
materials.body: The materials library and stock movements arrive in a later phase.

offline.pendingBody: {{count}} capture saved on this device, waiting for a connection.

theme.label: Theme
theme.hint: Light is the crisp white console. Dark is the matte charcoal one.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: This switches the whole app between English and Arabic.

gallery.searchPlaceholder: Search name, code, fabric or colour
gallery.emptyBody: Add your first dress by hand, or photograph one in the Capture phase.
gallery.emptyFilteredBody: Try another word or clear the filters.
gallery.loadFailedBody: Check your connection, then try again.

dress.publicCardSubtitle: A closer look at one dress.
dress.staffOnlyBody: This code is for the atelier team. Ask them for access.
dress.publicCardFooter: Shared by the atelier. Prices and availability on request.
dress.draftBanner: Draft — review the AI suggestions below and tap Apply to finalize.
dress.photosEmpty: Photos arrive later in the Capture phase.
dress.deleteWarning: The dress disappears from the gallery. You can undo for a few seconds.

errors.codeRequired: Enter a code for this dress.
errors.duplicateCode: This code is already used by another dress. Pick a different code.
errors.saveFailed: Saving failed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.loadFailedBody: Check your connection, then try again.
errors.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted. Check the gallery.

table.columnsHint: Tap a column to show or hide it. Your choice is remembered on this device.
table.selectAll: Select all rows on this page

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Your atelier today.
dashboard.headline: Today at the atelier
dashboard.attentionEmpty: No dresses yet. Add one from the Dresses tab.

export.title: Export
export.showPrices: Show prices on the printed pages
export.englishOnlyNote: Exports are English only. Arabic exports can be added later if needed.
export.tooManyRows: Exports run in the browser up to {{limit}} dresses. Contact the owner for bigger exports.
export.failed: Export failed. Check your connection and try again.

photos.empty: No photos yet, or still uploading.
photos.uploadFailed: Uploading one or more photos failed. Check your connection and try again.
photos.deleteFailed: Removing the photo failed. Try again.

ai.title: AI draft
ai.hint: Review and edit before saving. AI only describes what is visible.
ai.needsPhotos: Add at least one photo first.
ai.noKey: No vision key configured. Add one in Tools and APIs.
ai.notSignedIn: Your session expired. Sign in again and retry.
ai.badImage: The photos could not be read. Upload them again and retry.
ai.providerFailed: The AI service did not answer. Try again in a moment.
ai.parseFailed: The AI answer could not be read. Try again.
ai.rateLimited: The AI service is busy right now. Wait a moment and describe again.
ai.notAGarmentBody: This photo does not show a garment. The AI read it as "{subject}", so it was not described.
ai.notAGarmentBodyNoSubject: This photo does not show a garment, so it was not described.
ai.gapWarning: {count} details were not visible in the photos. Add more angles, or fill them in yourself.
ai.modelNote: Drafted by the active vision model.

cleanup.title: Clean background
cleanup.failed: Background removal failed. Check your connection or the API key.
cleanup.note: Originals are never overwritten. Re-styling needs no new API call.

movements.datesRequired: From and to dates are required.
movements.conflict: This dress already has an overlapping reservation.
movements.saveFailed: Saving failed. Check your connection and try again.

tools.title: Tools and APIs
tools.hint: Admin only. Keys are stored securely and never shown again.
tools.publicPageHint: When on, a customer who scans the QR on a hang tag sees the dress card and description. Nothing else is public.
tools.publicPageOn: On — the QR link shows the dress
tools.publicPageOff: Off — the QR link shows nothing
tools.publicPageLoadFailed: The setting could not be read.
tools.publicPageSaveFailed: The setting could not be saved.
tools.noVault: Vault storage is not available in this environment.
tools.securityNote: Keys are write-only: only the last 4 characters are ever shown.

branding.title: Atelier branding
branding.hint: The name and logo printed on the hang tags and the catalogue, and shown on the public page a customer reaches by scanning the QR code.
branding.nameSaved: The name is saved. New tags and catalogues will use it.
branding.loadFailed: Could not read the current branding.
branding.logoHint: A PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 2 MB. It is shown next to the QR code on the hang tag and on the public page. A transparent background works best.
branding.logoFailed: Could not upload the logo. A PNG, JPG or WebP under 2 MB.

capture.title: Capture
capture.subtitle: Photograph or upload a dress.
capture.cameraUnavailable: The camera could not be started. Another app may be using it.
capture.cameraTaken: The camera was closed by another app.
capture.cameraDenied: Camera not available. Use “Upload photos” instead.
capture.saveFailed: Saving failed. Check your connection and try again.
capture.queuedBody: There is no connection right now, so these photos are waiting on the tablet. They will upload automatically when the signal comes back.
capture.note: Photos are resized in the browser. Originals are kept.

pwa.installPrompt: Install the atelier app on this device

share.pageSubtitle: A private look at selected dresses.
share.unavailableTitle: This link is no longer available
share.unavailableBody: It may have expired or been revoked. Ask the atelier for a new link.
share.footerNote: Shared by the atelier. Prices appear only when they chose to show them.
share.showPrices: Include the price on the link
share.created: Link created. Anyone with it can see the dresses.

errors.title: Fault
errors.unknownBody: The app hit an unexpected state. Reload to start clean; nothing was saved.
errors.profileBody: Check your connection and that the database migrations and access policies are applied.
errors.forbiddenTitle: This page is for admins only
errors.forbiddenBody: Ask the owner for an admin account, or go back to the dresses.
errors.notFoundBody: Check the link, or go back to the dresses.
